verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Namecheap has a live API endpoint (api.namecheap.com/xml.response) and sandbox environment (api.sandbox.namecheap.com), and RDAP domain lookup responses confirming domain data can be queried programmatically, but there is no documentation shown for a dedicated domain availability/check API method, its parameters, or rate limits. missing for 10: actual domain-availability/check API method documentation, explicit rate-limit details, authentication/setup guide, and independent developer corroboration of successful programmatic use.
